comments.quote: In November 2004, an anonymous post circulated the web featuring a timestamped dialogue from the Diskette portal. While the post was popularly decried as a hoax online, others cited similar experiences, leading many to believe Diskette had been hacked, gone rogue, or was being sabotaged by the development team.
